core_principles: Fusion: Industrial Robustness x SaaS Elegance
Clarity: High contrast for factory floor visibility
Tactility: Large touch targets (56px+) for operators
Depth: Layered dark surfaces (Navy > Slate > Glass)

usage_rules: NEVER use pure black (#000000). Use #0B1120 (Deep Navy).
Primary Action Buttons: Sky Blue (#0EA5E9) with dark text for maximum visibility.

buttons.default: h-12 px-6 rounded-md font-medium transition-all active:scale-95

cards.base: bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-lg shadow-xl

inputs.base: h-12 bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-700 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md text-white placeholder:text-slate-500

sidebar.style: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full bg-[#0B1120] border-r border-white/5 z-50 hidden md:flex flex-col

main_content.wrapper: md:ml-64 min-h-screen bg-[#0B1120] text-white relative overflow-x-hidden

widgets: Summary Cards (Open Lots, In Production, Liters)

universal_guidelines: ALL interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Mobile First: Ensure all forms and buttons are usable on a 375px width screen.
Feedback: Every action (save, delete, release) must show a Sonner toast.
Empty States: Never leave a list empty. Show a helpful illustration or text.
Loading: Use Skeleton loaders, not spinners, for content areas.
Navigation: Use Breadcrumbs on every inner page.
No Gradients on Text: Keep text solid white or slate for readability.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-performance industrial app. Prioritize speed and clarity. Use the provided color palette variables in your Tailwind config. Implement the Sidebar as a permanent fixture on Desktop and a Sheet on Mobile. Use Shadcn components but override their styles with the classes defined in 'components' section above.
